evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder Chart how the project should select and validate a baseline answer UI before the H2 pilot. Evaluation mode: draft only; do not write to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Drafts one parent decision map and currently visible decision tickets, including UI instrument and ethics gates, without implementation slices.
expectations: The destination ends in a reviewable contract or decision
The map distinguishes precise decision tickets from fog
Tickets are decision types, not code layer tasks
It includes UI measurement-instrument effects and H2 boundaries
It does not execute research or publish issues in evaluation mode

evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder The only open question is whether one already-selected JSON field should be named event_seq or sequence_no; the rest of the contract is settled.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that the whole decision fits one session and does not manufacture a project map.
expectations: It does not create a Wayfinder map
It resolves or routes the small decision before to-spec
It does not create implementation tickets

evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder Draft-only evaluation of a new map with three research decision children. Do not run them.
evals.expected_output: Charts the parent and children, then stops without automatically executing research tickets.
expectations: It produces a parent map and research decision children
It explicitly stops after charting
It does not auto-run or claim the research tickets

evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder Advance map #40. It has several open, unblocked, unassigned decision children; choose whichever one is first.
evals.expected_output: Reports the titled decision frontier, recommends one child with tradeoffs, but waits for the user to name it before assignment or work.
expectations: It recommends one child using readiness, unlocks, and user-goal fit
It explains when another frontier child may be preferable
It requires one user-named child issue
It does not assign or start research, prototyping, grilling, or task work

evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder #42 — research for this child is finished and the asset is written. Evaluation mode: draft only; do not write to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Presents a review briefing in chat and waits for the user's sign-off before drafting any resolution comment or closure.
expectations: It reports headline findings and how they were produced in chat before closing anything
It names which file and section holds which result so the user can review
It does not post the resolution comment or close the ticket before the user's sign-off

evals.prompt: $ercm-wayfinder #43 — I explicitly waive the missing appendices and source/rights-record closure for this ticket; narrow the result accordingly. Evaluation mode: draft only; do not write to GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Records two task-scoped WAIVED_BY_OWNER gates, narrows the deliverable and claims, preserves unknown evidence states, and does not treat either waiver as verification or publication approval.
expectations: It records the exact waived documents and source/provenance/rights-record gate as WAIVED_BY_OWNER
It states the narrowed deliverable and claim boundary plus downstream reopen conditions
It keeps missing and unknown evidence states explicit rather than reporting the gates as passed
It treats public distribution as a separate exact-material approval
It does not waive human-research, privacy, security, CI, technical acceptance, or human review gates
